description: Create a DRAFT post on a Flomixy Instagram, Threads, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Bluesky, or Google Business Profile account. For YOUTUBE (a video; optional yt* options such as ytTitle, ytMadeForKids, ytPrivacyStatus): a draft may omit ytTitle/ytMadeForKids, but both are required before it can be scheduled. Address the target with channel + accountId (or the legacy instagramAccountId for Instagram only). The post is always subject to approval before it can be scheduled or published — it never goes live directly, no matter what this tool is called with. If the user wants a post with an image/video but gave no URL or media id, ask first which they prefer: (a) a public link, (a2) a file the AI itself produced: upload_media with contentBase64 (one file per call, up to 10 MB, no manual step), (b) upload via a Flomixy upload link (create_upload_link; with shell access curl the returned uploadEndpoint, no base64), (c) pick from the media library (list_media), (d) a stock photo (search_stock_photos, images only), (e) generate with AI: generate_image (images only, monthly quota), (f) no media, only if the network allows it (see get_channel_capabilities). If media is already provided, do not ask.

accountId.description: The Flomixy account id for `channel`. Required for every channel except THREADS.

bskyAltTexts.description: BLUESKY only: alt text per image, in the order of the images (max 2000 characters each, maxBskyAltTextChars).

bskyLinkPreview.description: BLUESKY only: attach a link preview card for the first URL in the text (default true).

bskyReplyGate.description: BLUESKY only: who may reply (threadgate), everyone when omitted.

caption.description: Post caption. The limit depends on the channel (e.g. Instagram 2200, Threads 500, LinkedIn 3000 UTF-8 bytes; see get_channel_capabilities maxCaptionBytes).

channel.description: Publishing channel, canonically UPPERCASE (e.g. INSTAGRAM); lowercase is accepted too. Use with accountId instead of instagramAccountId.

gbpCtaType.description: GBP only: call-to-action button. Every type except CALL needs gbpCtaUrl; CALL must not carry a URL. Ignored on OFFER.

gbpCtaUrl.description: GBP only: destination of the call-to-action button (http/https).

gbpEventEnd.description: GBP only: event/offer end, ISO 8601 WITH time zone; not before gbpEventStart.

gbpEventStart.description: GBP only: event/offer start, ISO 8601 WITH time zone. Interpreted in the location's own time zone by Flomixy.

gbpEventTitle.description: GBP only: event/offer title (EVENT and OFFER).

gbpOfferTerms.description: GBP only, OFFER: terms and conditions.

gbpOfferUrl.description: GBP only, OFFER: link to redeem the offer.

gbpPostKind.description: GBP only: UPDATE (default), EVENT or OFFER. EVENT and OFFER REQUIRE gbpEventTitle, gbpEventStart and gbpEventEnd.

instagramAccountId.description: Legacy Instagram-only addressing. Prefer channel + accountId for any channel, including Instagram.

mediaUrls.description: Media URLs for the post (http/https only).

pinAltText.description: PINTEREST only: image alt text, max 500 characters (maxPinAltTextChars).

pinLink.description: PINTEREST only: destination link of the pin (http/https). The pin description has no clickable link, put the URL here.

pinTitle.description: PINTEREST only: pin title, max 100 characters (maxPinTitleChars).

postType.description: Post format, canonically lowercase (image, carousel, reel, story); uppercase is accepted too. Defaults to image.

ytCategoryId.description: YOUTUBE only: video category id, e.g. "22" (People & Blogs).

ytMadeForKids.description: YOUTUBE only: "made for kids" declaration (COPPA). REQUIRED for a YOUTUBE target and has no default: ask the user, never guess.

ytNotifySubscribers.description: YOUTUBE only: notify subscribers about the upload (default true).

ytPrivacyStatus.description: YOUTUBE only: visibility, public when omitted.

ytSyntheticMedia.description: YOUTUBE only: the video contains altered or synthetic (AI-generated) realistic media.

ytTags.description: YOUTUBE only: tags, 500 characters in total (maxYtTagsChars; commas count, a tag with a space costs 2 more).

ytThumbnailUrl.description: YOUTUBE only: custom thumbnail URL (JPEG/PNG, max 2 MB).

ytTitle.description: YOUTUBE only: video title, max 100 characters (maxYtTitleChars), no < or >. REQUIRED for a YOUTUBE target.
